01 · The problem

Almost every “factory” still runs
on paper and chat apps.

ERP exists only on office PCs and monitors
✓ The ERP sits on a desk in the office — it books the ledger after the month closes, and scores compliance after the audit.
✗ Nobody built the layer where the daily work starts — where workers, managers, the corporate office and the customers work together on one platform. Today that layer is e-mail, WhatsApp, WeChat and Telegram.
1 · The brands
Buyers are adopting Ai-native platforms for sales, distribution and sustainability — and the factory answers with an Excel sheet e-mailed on Friday. No live data, no plug-in, no order.
2 · The government
Government is digitalising fast — taxation, employment, customs documentation, sustainability compliance, environmental data. It wants real data, fast, and penalises late. The factory still files by hand.
3 · The society
The country is converting into a digital economy and the public is adopting a digital way of living — while the factory still works the 1980s way: ledger books and chat apps nobody can search.
4 · ASEAN challenge
Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines — even China — want to win the soft-goods industry back with Ai-native technology. A Cambodian factory that stays analogue loses the order to the neighbour that didn't.
